caveats: The VTEC baseline is a Laplace, and its stored vtec_model_stec_total_unc is already a standard deviation (sqrt(2) * scale), not the raw scale - recover the scale as std / sqrt(2) before any Laplace formula sees it.
Scored as a Gaussian the same data reads 90% coverage at nominal 50% against 82% under Laplace; both scorings are emitted side by side, tagged by which likelihood is native to each model.
The storm/quiet split uses the daily minimum-Dst rule at -50 nT, matching storm_stratification.STORM_DST_THRESHOLD_NT - not the per-observation rule in scenario_evaluation.py.
description: coverage, PIT and CRPS for Direct STEC and VTEC + Mapping, each under its own likelihood and regime
